# Trustify Sports

> AML and KYC compliance for professional football clubs and football agents under the EU Anti-Money Laundering Regulation (AMLR), Regulation (EU) 2024/1624: a compliance platform built for football, compliance experts who guide implementation, and ongoing support.

Key facts:
- Professional football clubs and football agents are obliged entities under the AMLR from 10 July 2029.
- Clubs are obliged for four transaction types only: with investors; with sponsors and advertisers; with football agents and other intermediaries; and player transfers.
- Every football agent is an obliged entity, regardless of size, with no exemption.
- Football associations and leagues are not obliged entities.
- Clubs and agents are supervised by national AML supervisors. AMLA, the EU Anti-Money Laundering Authority, sets technical standards and coordinates supervision.
- Trustify Sports never files suspicious-transaction reports on a client's behalf; the club or agent files with its FIU.
- Trustify Sports supports compliance but does not provide legal advice.
